prompt: I'm starting a new Tailwind v4 + React project for a SaaS dashboard. Small team (3 devs), no Figma, no React Native. Our brand color is #6366f1 (indigo). Set up a proper design token system with dark mode support. Give me the complete tokens.css and app.css files ready to drop in.
assertions: Uses OKLCH color format for at least one primitive color value (not hex or hsl)
Declares primitive vars (like --indigo-500 or --brand-500) separate from semantic vars (like --primary, --background)
app.css uses @theme inline (not plain @theme) to map semantic color vars into --color-* Tailwind utilities
Explains why @theme inline is used instead of plain @theme, OR explains the dark mode mechanism
